name: conservation_profile
description: Position-specific conservation from homologs: align every homolog to the query with Needleman-Wunsch and report the WT frequency and Shannon entropy per position.

name: query_domain_architecture_panel
description: Batch domain-architecture summary for a candidate panel: Pfam families + signalling-domain flags from UniProt cross-references (no per-gene REST call beyond the batch UniProt query).

name: query_interpro
description: InterPro/Pfam domain architecture of a protein, with a compact flag set for signalling domain families (kinase, 7TM/GPCR, LRR, Frizzled, death domain, phosphatase, ...).

name: query_quickgo
description: Gene Ontology annotations of a protein (QuickGO): molecular function / biological process / cellular component, evidence codes and a derived signalling-annotation score.

name: druggability_score
description: Composite druggability score (0-1) from ChEMBL ligand volume, DGIdb interactions and Open Targets tractability buckets.

name: is_buyable
description: Check whether a molecule is in the curated building-block stock.

name: molecule_properties
description: Parse a SMILES string and report identity/descriptor/functional-group information used by the retrosynthesis planner.

name: one_step_disconnections
description: Enumerate plausible one-step retrosynthetic disconnections of a molecule using the curated template set, returning sanitised precursor sets with template name and cost.

meta.max_precursors: discard disconnections producing more fragments than this

name: query_chembl_target
description: ChEMBL target lookup and ligand statistics for a gene: target id, number of bioactivities, number of distinct compounds and the best clinical phase — a direct druggability signal.

name: query_dgidb
description: DGIdb drug–gene interactions (approved / investigational drugs, interaction types).

name: fetch_homologs
description: Retrieve homolog sequences from UniProt for conservation analysis.

meta.query: UniProt query selecting the homolog family

name: query_cbioportal_alterations
description: Mutation and copy-number alteration frequency for a gene in TCGA-COADREAD (mutation count, % mutated samples, % amplified, % deep-deleted).

name: query_cbioportal_coexpression
description: Co-expression of a query gene with a panel of candidates in TCGA-COADREAD: Pearson r, p-value, BH-FDR and the number of shared samples (single matrix download, cached).

meta.anchor_gene: gene whose expression is the reference (e.g. DPEP1)

name: query_cbioportal_expression
description: TCGA-COADREAD expression of a gene: tumour mRNA distribution, z-score versus matched normal, fraction of tumours with z>2 (over-expression), and the number of profiled samples.

name: query_cbioportal_expression_panel
description: Expression profile of many genes in TCGA-COADREAD: mean z-score vs normal, fraction of tumours with z>2 and median mRNA per gene (used for panel-level filtering).

name: query_cbioportal_survival
description: Kaplan–Meier analysis for a gene in TCGA-COADREAD: median mRNA split, log-rank p-value, hazard ratio and per-group median survival. Endpoint selectable (OS/DFS/DSS/PFS).

name: query_opentargets_associations
description: Open Targets gene–disease associations: overall association profile, the score for a disease of interest (default MONDO_0005575 = colorectal cancer) and the top associated diseases.

meta.top_n: how many top diseases to return

name: query_opentargets_known_drugs
description: Known drugs / clinical candidates for a target from Open Targets (druggability proxy).

name: query_opentargets_target
description: Open Targets target profile: Ensembl id, biotype, function descriptions, pathway membership, subcellular localisation, tractability buckets and safety liabilities.

name: query_uniprot
description: Fetch a UniProt entry: sequence, topology (TM / GPI-anchor / signal peptide), domains, subcellular location, function and GO annotations. Use it to test whether a protein can transduce a signal itself (transmembrane + intracellular domain) or is an ectoenzyme/GPI protein.

name: query_uniprot_batch
description: Batch-fetch topology/domain summaries for many proteins at once (used by the signaling potential scorer). Returns one compact record per gene.

name: resolve_gene_ids
description: Map HGNC symbols to Entrez / Ensembl identifiers in batch (mygene.info). Every cross-database tool needs this.

name: compile_sdl
description: Compile parsed protocol steps into an SDL program: typed opcodes with SI units, device assignment, vessel, and per-step duration.

meta.vessel: default vessel type if the protocol does not state one

name: parse_protocol
description: Parse a natural-language wet-lab protocol into typed steps with volumes, temperatures, durations, speeds and reagents; unparsable sentences are returned explicitly.

meta.protocol_text: protocol as a list of sentences (or one string)

name: simulate_sdl
description: Simulate an SDL program on the device model: per-step start/end times, device occupancy and consumable usage.

name: validate_sdl
description: Statically validate an SDL program: vessel capacity, device temperature limits, missing units, non-positive durations, flammable-solvent hazards and basic ordering constraints.

name: citation_network_score
description: Composite literature score for a gene: co-mention with the anchor, disease specificity (gene+disease / gene total) and novelty — the three signals the critic asks for.

name: fetch_pubmed_abstracts
description: Fetch abstracts for the top PubMed hits of a query (used by the critic to check whether an association is mechanistic or only correlative).

name: query_pubmed
description: PubMed search: returns the total hit count, the publication trend and the top records (title, journal, year, PMID, DOI). Use it for evidence retrieval and novelty assessment.

name: query_pubmed_cooccurrence
description: Literature co-mention analysis: for each gene, how many PubMed records co-mention it with the anchor gene (and, optionally, the disease). Returns counts + example PMIDs.

meta.disease: optional disease term added to the query

name: query_pubmed_novelty
description: Novelty assessment for a candidate target: PubMed volume for gene+CRC, gene+therapy and gene+drug queries, plus a saturation score (0 = heavily studied, 1 = unexplored).

name: build_ppi_union
description: Union of STRING + IntAct partners, with a combined association score (max of STRING combined and IntAct interaction-count score). This is the PPI branch of candidate generation.

name: query_intact
description: IntAct curated physical / binary protein interactions for a protein (MI-annotated, experiment-backed). Complements STRING for direct binding evidence.

name: query_string
description: STRING interaction partners of a protein with per-channel scores (experimental, database, text-mining, co-expression). The experimental score is the strongest association evidence.

name: pathway_coannotation
description: Shared-pathway analysis between an anchor gene and candidates (Reactome/KEGG/GO): number of shared terms, Jaccard similarity and the anchor's own terms.

name: query_kegg_pathways
description: KEGG pathway membership for a single gene (official KEGG REST link + list endpoints).

name: query_pathway_enrichment
description: Hypergeometric enrichment of a gene list against a gene-set library with BH-FDR. Used to characterise the candidate pool (e.g. is it a Wnt / receptor-tyrosine-kinase module?).

meta.top_n: number of enriched terms to return

name: query_pathway_membership
description: Pathway/process membership for a gene list from a curated gene-set library (Reactome_2022, KEGG_2021_Human, GO_Biological_Process_2023); returns terms per gene and the most frequently shared terms.

name: route_metrics
description: Summarise a route: number of steps, template usage, leaf building blocks, approximate atom economy and a 0-1 confidence score.

name: search_route
description: Best-first recursive retrosynthesis search from a target to the curated building-block stock, returning the best route tree with per-step templates and total cost.

name: multi_evidence_scoring
description: Rank candidate effector targets on six evidence dimensions (association, signalling competence, disease expression/prognosis, pathway centrality, novelty, druggability) with critic-calibrated weights, coverage-aware renormalisation and a consistency check.

meta.candidates: list of evidence dicts, each with a 'gene' key

name: score_signaling_potential
description: Score proteins for intrinsic signalling competence (0-1) from UniProt topology, Pfam domain family, function annotation and localisation. GPI-anchored and secreted proteins are capped.

name: design_primers_from_cds
description: Map a protein position onto a coding sequence (by translated-frame matching) and design the corresponding QuikChange primer pair with GC content and T_m.

meta.protein_sequence: protein sequence the positions refer to
meta.mutations: list of 'wt>mut' strings, parallel to positions
meta.flank: flanking nucleotides on each side of the codon

name: design_quikchange_primers
description: Design a QuikChange site-directed mutagenesis primer pair for a codon change, with GC content and T_m, using the coding sequence and the target position.

meta.flank: number of flanking nucleotides on each side

name: fetch_nucleotide_sequence
description: Download a CDS/mRNA sequence from ENA by accession (e.g. the EMBL id cross-referenced by UniProt).

name: fetch_alphafold_model
description: Download and parse the AlphaFold DB model for a UniProt accession: per-residue CA coordinates, contact numbers (burial), and pLDDT confidence.

name: pocket_geometry
description: Heavy-atom geometry of positions relative to the annotated active/binding-site cluster: minimum side-chain-to-site distance (A), burial (CA contact number) and pLDDT. This is the structure signal used by the enzyme-engineering scorer.
